title: Guides
html:
In this Guides section we have Guides about everything, how to farm bosses, what-to-do-next Guides, Item guides and many more! Take a look around, and we hope you will find them very useful!

Contents

  • 1 Guides to Using this Wiki
  • 2 Main Guides
  • 3 Special Guides
  • 4 Boss Guides
  • 5 Tips and Hints
  • 6 Third Party Pages

Guides to Using this Wiki

FAQ
  • The Frequently asked Questions about the Wiki, not about the game.
Page Entry Guides
  • Specific templates for pages on Quests, Monsters, NPC's and other categories to make it easy to quickly enter new information.
Wiki Code Guide
  • The codes to add links, images and other things to your entries.

Main Guides

Newbies Start Here
  • A list of pages in this Wiki for Beginners.


Beginner's FAQ
  • Answers to all the basic questions that newbies have so often.


Glossary
  • is a category of abbreviations and articles on terms used by Dungeon Runners players and the game itself.


Interface Guide
  • This will explain every little detail about options that can be changed, how the interface works and how to access all the in-game settings. This guide uses many images which should make it relatively easy to understand.


Boss Guide
  • An interactive work-in-progress to gather tips from successful players on tactics for solos and groups against the various Bosses.

Special Guides

I'm in Dew Valley. Now What?
  • A humorous but informative guide to first starting out.


The Elements and How To Use Them
  • Fire, Ice, Shadow, Divine and Poison are the elements of this game. This guide will tell more about how to use them and where.


Two Skills Mage
  • Combinations and resulting character class names specifically for mages.


Farming
  • The fine art of farming gold, rainbows or xp; where and how to do it.


Stat Choices
  • How to distribute your leveling points effectively.


Beginning Classes
  • The three basic classes.


Dancing With Yourself
  • The great philosopher Billy Idol has much to teach us about DR.

Boss Guides

Boss Guide
  • An interactive work-in-progress covering ALL bosses. ADD your tips!
  • Level 100 Boss Guide: The bosses that are recommended up to L100.


Sissirat Guide
  • This guide will show you how to beat Sissirat fast and effectively!


Vergrim Killer Mage
  • Vergrim is difficult for a solo mage. This will show you a build and strategy for defeating him.


Pyromancer Toasting Rotgut
  • How to defeat Rotgut quickly and easily using Fire attacks.

Tips and Hints

Tip: Object collection quests
  • Will explain everything about doing quests faster by dropping the items and do the quest over again, so that you can later pick up all quest items and simply get more rewards easier!
Tip: Trading With Yourself
  • Many methods have been devised to trade with your other characters. Here are several methods. (Includes the tip previously under The Potion Mule for getting potions cheaply.)
Tip: Dancing With Yourself
  • How to farm a Boss at loot up to +1150%, even solo.
Tip: Gym Freak and Bookworm -- the Odd Couple
  • These two very diverse Passive Skills can work together in a very beneficial way.
Tip: The Two Button Mage
  • How to find the best timing for your basic Mage skills,
Tip: GoS Hates Divines!
  • A little know secret about the GoS offs from The Shadow's Embrace allows you to let the monsters powerlevel you!
Tip: Trade Stash as additional Inventory!
  • Too much to carry in your inventory? Use your Trade Stash too!
Tip: Health and mana bars
  • How you can choose to have your health and mana display right over your head.
Tip: More Relics on Normal
  • Better Relics from a Normal Dungeon.
Tip: Insane Boss with Normal Spawn
  • Save some pots by doing spawning minions on normal.
Tip: Equipment Sets
  • How to improve attribute bonuses by selecting similar items.
Tip:Play Test Server the easy way
  • You don't have to download the entire game again to get on the PTS.

Third Party Pages

(These will link to pages out of the wiki.)

IdeaRunners
  • Unofficial Idea site monitored by the developers of Dungeon Runners.
Horrific Domain of Legend
  • A beautiful and fact filled fansite.

Character Viewing Sheets: 3rd party character viewers, where one can see other players' equipment.

  • ThreePlanetsSoftware Viewing
  • DR Players Viewing
  • Lord Magnus' Viewer

Dungeon Maps: besides those located on the Dungeon Article page.

  • Lord Magnus' map A large downloadable map of all dungeons.
  • Ethan's Printer Friendly Maps Black and White maps for quick and easy printing.
  • Dungeon Runners Map Build 0.110 - JoeB1978 This classic map will show all the dungeons, subdungeons, outposts and more of Dungeon Runners (AS OF VERSION 110, so it is a bit outdated). It is extremely handy for those that do not know what dungeons they actually can run.
